document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You knife into the water like an Olympic star and feel your 
hands touch bottom. The water is cool. Heart hammering, you 
surface and make mighty strokes to the bank. The sasquatches 
above hoot and scream in frustration. But it would take them 
an hour to pursue you down the cliff.
